headline.zh: 民主党横扫国会，伊朗战争成败因
headline.en: Democrats sweep Congress as Iran war and data centers sink GOP

lede.zh: 美国中期选举中，民主党同时拿下参众两院，特朗普承认伊朗战争拖累了共和党，副总统万斯也开始与这场战争划清界限。选民还几乎在所有投票中否决了数据中心项目，给AI基建热潮泼了冷水；股市却大涨，道指涨约1500点。AI领域，OpenAI展示了自动发现并修补近千个Linux内核漏洞的系统，中国开源模型也再迎新品。
lede.en: Democrats took both chambers of Congress in a midterm rout that Trump himself partly blamed on the Iran war, while JD Vance began edging away from it. Voters also rejected data centers in nearly every ballot measure, a blow to the AI buildout, even as stocks rallied and the Dow gained 1,500 points. In AI, OpenAI showed an autonomous system that found and patched nearly a thousand Linux kernel bugs, and new open-weight models kept arriving.

headline.zh: 美国投票日，AI 的账单摊开了
headline.en: America votes, and AI's bill comes due

lede.zh: 昨天，美国人投票决定国会归属，特朗普剩下两年的政治空间就此揭晓；与此同时，美伊一边空袭一边谈判，霍尔木兹海峡的命运或在两天内见分晓。AI 世界则迎来一次“对账”：Anthropic 晒出 170 亿美元季度收入，也晒出更深的亏损，科技巨头 3.2 万亿美元的隐形承诺让市场开始紧张。
lede.en: Yesterday Americans voted on who controls Congress — and how much room Trump has for his final two years — while the US and Iran traded strikes and offers, with the Strait of Hormuz's fate possibly clear within two days. In AI it was a day of reckoning: Anthropic showed $17 billion in quarterly revenue alongside deeper losses, and $3.2 trillion in Big Tech's hidden AI commitments put markets on edge.
